m: अर्ह् cl. 1. P. अर्हति, rarely Ā. अर्हते [MBh. iii, 1580; R.], (p. अर्हत् [see below]; Ved. Inf. अर्हसे [RV. x, 77, 1]; perf. 3. pl. आनर्हुः, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 39, Sch., but Ved. आनृहुः [cf. आनृचुः, √ अर्च्] Pāṇ. vi, 1, 36) to deserve, merit, be worthy of, to have a claim to, be entitled to (acc.), to be allowed to do anything (Inf.); to be obliged or required to do anything (acc.); to be worth, counterbalance, to be able; (अर्हसि, 2. sg. with an Inf. is often used as a softened form of Imper.; e.g. दातुम् अर्हसि, ‘be pleased to give’; श्रोतुम् अर्हसि, ‘deign to listen’, for शृणु) : Caus. (Opt. अर्हयेत्, Mn. iii, 3 and 119; aor., आर्जिहत्, Bhaṭṭ.) to honour. Desid. अर्जिहिषति [cf. Gk. ἄρχω].
a: अर्ह् — {c1c} P. [अर्हति, अर्हितुं, आनर्ह, अर्हित] (epic A. as रावणो नार्हते पूजां Rām.) 1 To deserve, merit, be worthy of (with acc. or inf.); किमिव नायुष्मानमरेश्वरान्नार्हति Ś. 7; so दंडं, प्रायश्चित्तं, वधं &c. --2 To have a right to, be entitled to, be allowed to do any thing (with acc.); ननु गर्भः पित्र्यं रिक्थमर्हति Ś. 6; न स्त्री स्वातंत्र्यमर्हति Ms. 9. 3; also with inf.; न स तल्लब्धुमर्हति Ms. 8. 147; 11. 7, 18. --3 To be obliged or required to do a thing, oft. implying duty or obligation; नान्यत्स्त्री दातुमर्हति Y. 2. 49; इमां प्रसादयितुमर्हसि R. 1. 88. --4 To be fit or deserve to be done; अर्थना मयि भवद्भिः कर्तुमर्हति N. 5. 112; Dk. 137. --5 To be equal to; be worth, न ते गात्राण्युपचारमर्हंति Ś. 3. 18 are not equal to; सर्वे ते जपयज्ञस्य कलां नार्हंति षोडशीं Ms. 2. 86; 3. 131. --6 To be able, translateable by ‘can’; न मे वचनमन्यथा भवितुमर्हति Ś. 4; विनाशमव्ययस्यास्य न कश्चित्कर्तुमर्हति Bg. 2. 17; अनुद्योगेन तैलानि तिलेभ्यो नाप्तुमर्हति H. Pr. 30 cannot get. --7 To worship, honour; see caus. below. --8 (Used with inf. in the second pers. and sometimes in the third) अर्ह् represents a mild form of command, advice or courteous request, and may be translated by ‘pray’, ‘deign’, ‘be pleased to’, ‘will be pleased to’; द्वित्राण्यहान्यर्हसि सोढुमर्हन् R. 5. 25 pray wait &c; नार्हसि मे प्रणयं विहंतुं 2. 58; तं संतः श्रोतुमर्हंति 1. 10 will be pleased or be good enough to listen to it; Ku. 6. 32; Ms. 1. 2; Bg. 10. 16, 2. 17; R. 1. 72; 1. 88; 3. 46. --Caus. or {c10c} P. To honour, worship; राजार्जिहत्तं मधुपर्कपाणिः Bk. 1. 17; Ms. 3. 3, 119.

अर्हंती — The quality of being fit to be worshipped, veneration, adoration; श्रौत्रार्हंतीचणैर्गुण्यैः Sk.
अर्हंत — a. [अर्ह्र-बा˚ झ] Worthy, deserving. --तः 1 A Buddha. --2 A Buddhist mendicant. --3 N. of Śiva.

kazati hinastyAtmAnaM kugatiprApaRAditi kazAyaHkroDo mAno mAyA loBaSca । sa dviviDaH SuBASuBaBedAt tatrAhiMsAdiH SuBaH kAyayogaH satyamitahitaBAzaRAdiH SuBo vAmyogaH । tadetadAsravaBedapraBedajAtaM kAyavANmanaHkarmmayogaH sa AsravaH SuBaH puRqasya, aSuBaH pApatyetyAdinA sUtrasandarBeRa sasaMramBamaBARi । apare tvevaM menire Asravayati puruzaM vizayezvindriyapravfttirAsravaH, indriyadvArA hi pOruzaM jyotirvizayAn spfSadrUpAdijYAnarUpeRa pariRamata iti । miTyAdarSanAviratipramAdakazAyavaSAdyogavaSAccAtmA sUkzmEkakzetrAvagAhinAmanantAntapradeSAnAM pudgalAnAM karspabanGayogyAnAmAdAnamupaSlepaRaM yat karoti sa banDaH । taduktaM “sakazAyatvAjjIvaH karmma BAvayogyAn pudgalAnAdattesa banDa” iti । tatra kazAyagrahaRaM sarvvabanDahetUpalakzaRArTam । banDahetUn papAWa vAcakAryyaH “miTyAdarSanAviratipramAdakazAyA banDahetavaH” iti । miTyAdarsanaM dviviDaM miTyAkarmmodayAt paropadeSAnapekzaM tattvASradDAnaM nEsargikamekam aparaM paropadeSajam । pfTivyAdizawkApAdAnakaM zaqindriyAsaMyamanaYca aviratiH ॥ paYcasaBitiguptizvanutsAhaH pramAdaH । kazAyaH kroDAdiH । tatra kazAyAntAH sTityanuBAvabanDahetavaH prakftipradeSabanDaheturyoga iti viBAgaH । banDaScaturviDa ityuktaM prakftisTityanuBAvapradeSAstu tadviDaya iti yaTA nimbaguqAdestiktatvamaGuratvAdisvaBAvaH evamAvaraRIyasya jYAnadarSanAvaraRatvamAdityapraBocCedakAmBoDaravat pradIpapraBAtirIDAyakakumBavacca sadasadvedanIyasya suKaduHKotpAdakatvamasiDArAmaDulehanavaddarSanamohanIyasya tattvArTASradDAnakAritvaM durjanasaNgavaccAritre mIhanIyasyAsaMyamahetutvaM madyamadavadAyuzo dehabanDakartftvaM jalavat nAmno vicitranAmakAritvaM citrikavadgotrasyoccanIcakAritvaM kumBakAravaddAnAdonAM viGnanidAnatvamantarAyasya svaBAvaH koSADyakzavat । so'yaM prakftivanDo'zwaviDaH dravyakarmmAvAntaraBedamUlaprakftivedanIyaH । taTAvocadumAsvAtivAcakAcAryyaH “Adyo jYAnadarSanAvaraRavedanIyamohanIyAyurnAmagotrAntarAyA” iti tadBedaYca samagfhRAt mADuryasvaBAvAdapracyutisTitiH taTA jYAnAvaraRAdInAM mUlaprakftInAmAditastisfRAmantarAyasya ca triMSatsAgaropamakowikowyaH parA sTitirityAdyuktaM kAladurdDAnavat svoyasvaBAvAdapracyutisTitiH । yaTA AtmapradeSAnupraveSaH pradeSabanDaH । AsravaniroDaH saMvaraH yenAtmani praviSat karmma pratiziDyate sa gupti samityAdiH saMvaraH । saMsArakAraRAdyogAdAtmanogopanaM guptiH । sA triviDA kAyavANmanonigrahaBedAt । prARipIqAparihAreRa samyagayanaM samitiH sA IrzyABAzAdiBedAt paYcaDA । prapaYcitaYca hemacandrAcAryyEH “lokAtivAhite mArge cumbite BAsvadaMSuBiH । janturakzArTamAlokya gatirorzyA matA satAm ॥ Apadya rAgataH sarvvajanInaM mitaBAzaRam । priyA vAcaMyamAnAM sA BAzAsamitirucyate ॥ dvicatvAriMSatA BikzAdozErnityamadUzitam । muniryadannamAdatte sEzaRAsamitirmatA ॥ AsanAdIni saMvIkzya pratilaNGya ca yatnataH । gfhRIyAnnikzipedDyAyet sA dAnasamitiH smftA ॥ kaPamUtramalaprAyErnirjantu jagatItale । “yatnAdyadu tsujet sADuH sotsargasamitirBavet” ॥ ata eva, “AsravaH srotaso dvAraM saMvfRotIti saMvaraH” iti nirAhuH taduktamaBiyuktEH “Asravo BavahetuH syAt svaMvaro mokzakAraRam । itIyamArhatI muzwiranyadasyAH prapaYcanam” ॥ arjitasya karmmaRastapaHpraBftiBirnirjaraRaM nirjarAKyaM tattvaM cirakAlapravfttakazAyakalApaM puRyaM sUKaduHKe ca dehena jarayati nASayati keSolluYcanAdikaM tapa ucyate । sA nirjarA dviviDA yaTAkAlOpakramikaBedAt tatra praTamA yasmin kAle yat karmma PalapradatvenABimataM tasminneva kAle PaladAnAdBavantI nirjarA kAmAdipAkajeti ca sA goyate । yat karmma tapobalAt svakAmanayodayAvaliM praveSya prapadyate tat karma nirjarA । yadAha “saMsAravIjaBUtAnAM karmmaRAM jaraRAdiha । nirjarA sammatA dveDA sakAmA kAmanirjarA ॥ smftA sakAmA yaminAmakAmA tvanyadehinAmiti” । miTyAdarSanAdInAM banDahetUnAM niroDaH aBinavakarmmABAvAt nirjarAhetusanniDAnenArjjitasya karmmaRo nirasabAdAtyantikakarmmamokzaRaM sokzaH banDahetuBavahetunirjarAByAM kftsnakarmmavipramokzaRaM mokza iti tadanantaramUrdDvaM gacCatyAlokAntAt yaTA hastadaRqAdiBramipreritaM kulAlacakramuparate'pi tasmin tadbalAdevAsaMskArakzayaM Bramati taTA BavasTenAtmamA apavargaprAptaye bahuSo yat kftaM praRiDAnaM muktasya tadamAve'pi pUrvvasaMskArAdAlokAntaM gamanamupapadyate yaTA vA mfttikAlepakftamalAvUdravyaM jale'DaHpatati punarapetamfttikAbanDamUrdDvaM gacCati taTA karmmarahita AtmA asaNgatvAdUrdDvaM gacCati banDacCedAderaRqavIjavaccordDvagatisvaBAvAccAgniSisvAvat । anyonyaM pradeSAnupraveSe satyaviBAgenAvasTAnaM banDaH parasparaprAptimAtraM saNgaH । taduktaM “pUrvvaprayogAdasaNgatvAdbanDacCedAttaTA gatipariRAmAccAvirudDaM kulAlacakravadvyapagatalepAlAbuvaderaRqavIjavadagniSiKAvacceti” । ataeva paWanti “gatvAgatvA nivarttante candrasUryyAdayo grahAH । adyApi na nivarttante tvAlokAkASamAgatA” iti ॥ anye tu gatasamastakleSatadvAsanasyAnAvaraRajYAnasya suKEkatAnasyAtmana uparideSAvasTAnaM muktirityAsTizata । evamuktAni suKaduHKasAGanAByAM puRyapAMpAByAM sahitAni nava padArTAn kecanANgIcakruH । taduktaM sidDAnte “jIvAjIvO puRyapApayutAvAsravaH saMvaro nirjaraRaM banDo mokzaSca nava tattvAnIti” । saNgrahepravfttA vayamuparatAH sma । atra sarvvatra saptaBaNginayAKyaM nyAyamavatArayanti jEnAH “syAdasti syAnnAsti syAdasti ca nAsti ca । syAdavaktavyaH syAdasti cAvaktavyaH syAnnAsti cAvaktavyaH syAdasti ca nAsti cAvaktavya iti” । tatsarvvamanantavIryyaH pratyapIpadat “tadviDAnavivakzAyAM syAdastIti gatirBavet । syAnnAstIti prayogaH syAttannizeGe vivakzite ॥ krameRoBayavAYCATAM prayogaH samudAyaBAk । yugapattadvivakzAyAM syAdavAcyamaSaktitaH ॥ AdyovAcyavivakzAyAM paYcamo BaNga izyate । antyovAcyAvivakzAyAM zazWoBaNgasamudBavaH ॥ samuccayena yuktaSca saptamo BaNga ucyata iti” । syAcCabdaH svalvayaM nipAtaH tiNantapratirUpako'nekAntadyotakaH । yaToktram “vAkyezvanekAntadyoti gamyaM prati viSezaRam । syAnnipAto'rTayogitvAttiNantapratirUpaka” iti ॥ yadi punarekAntadyotakaH syAcCabdo'yaM syAttadA syAdastoti vAkye syAtpadamanarTakaM syAt anekAntadyotakatve tu syAdasti kaTaYcidastIti syAtsyAtpadAt kaTaYciditi ayamarTo laByate iti nAnarTakyam । tadAha “syAdvAdaH sarvvaTEkAntatyAgAt kiM vftatadviDeH । saptaBaNginayApekzo heyAdeyaviSezakfditiH” ॥ yadi vastvalyekAntataH sarvvaTA sarvvatra sarvvAtmanAstIti na upAditsAjihAsAByAM kvacit kadA kenacitpravatteta nivartteta vA prAptaprApaRIyatvaheyahAnAnupapatteSca । anekAntapakze tu kaTaYcit kenacit sattvena hAnopAdAne prekzAvatAmupapadyete । kiYca vastunaH sattva svaBAvaH asattvaM yetyAdi prazwavyaM na tAvadastitvaM vastunaH svaBAva iti samasti zawo'stItyanayoH paryyAyatayA yugapatprayogAyogAt nAstIti prayogaviroDAcca evamanyatrApi yojyam । yaToktam “Gawo'stIti na vaktavyaM sanneva hi yato GawaH । nAstItyapi na vaktavyaM viroDAt sadasattvayorityAdi” tasmAditTaM vaktavyaM sadasatsadasadanirbDacanIyavAdaBedena prativAdinaScaturviDAH punarapyanirbDacanIyamatenAmiSritAni sadasadAdimatAnIti triviDAH tAn prati kiM vastvastItyAdiparyyanuyoge kaTaYcidastetvAdiprativacanasamBavena te vAdinaH sarvve nirviRRAH santaH tURImAsata iti sampUrRArTaviniScAyinaH syAdvAdamaNgIkurvvatastatra tatra vijaya iti sarvvamupapannam । yadavocadAcAryyaH syAdvAdamaYjaryyAm । “anekAntAtmakaM vastu gocaraH marvvasaMvidAm । ekadeSaviSizwo'rzo na yasya vizayo mataH ॥ nyAyAnAmekanizWAnAM pravfttO Srutavartmani । sampUrRArTaviniScAyi syAdvastu Srutamucyate “anyonyapakzapratipakzaBAvAdyaTApare matsariRaH prabAdAH । nayAnaSezAnaviSezamicCannapakzapAtI samayastaTArhataH” iti ॥ jinadattasUriRA jEnaM matamitTamuktam । “balaBogopaBogAnAmuBayordAnalABayoH । antarAyastaTA nidrA BIrajYAnaM jugupsitam । hiMsA ratyaratI rAgadvezO ratiratismaraH । Soko miTyAtvamete'zwAdaSa dIzA na yasya saH । jino devoguruH samyak tattvajYAnopadeSakaH । jYAnadarSanacAritrARyapavargasya vartmani । syAdvAdasya pramARe dve pratyakzamanumApi ca । nityAnityAtmalaM sarbDaMnava tattvAni sapta vA । jIvAjIvO puRyapApe cAsravaHsaMvaro'pi ca । banDo nirjaraRaM muktirezAM vyAKyADunocyate । cetanAlakzaRo jIvaH syAdajIvastadanyakaH । satkarmmapudgalAH puRyaM pApaM tasya viparyyayaH । AsravaH karmmaRAM banDo nirjarastadviyojanam ॥ azwakarmmakzayAnmIkzo'TAntarBAvaSca kEScana । puRyasya saMsrave pApasyAsrave kriyate punaH ॥ labDAnantacatuzkasya lokAgUQasya cAtmanaH । kzIRAzwakarmmaRomuktirnirvyAvfttirjinoditA sarajoharaRA BEkzaBujo luYcitamUrdDajAH । SvetAmbarAH kzamASIlAH niHsaNgA jEnasADavaH ॥ luYcitAH picCikAhastAH pARipAtrA digambarAH । UrdDvASino gfhe dAturdvitIyAH syurjinarzayaH ॥ BuNkte na kebalaM na strIM mokzameti digambaraH । prAhurezAmayaM BedomahAn SvetAmbarEH saheti” ॥

a: अर्हत् — a.
